resolution.note: piped-check hook refuses pgrep -f wait loops; lanes.md rule; test green

title: A wait loop on pgrep -f is refused with the PID-wait remedy
body:
Why: three lanes tonight (t-1s6hgra, t-89s6d98, t-swx5eqw) left wait loops 'while pgrep -f X' that never ended because the pattern matches the loop's own bash -c command line (same class as pkill -f); one such loop (pid 2560229) ran 4h.
Outcome: the Bash PreToolUse hook scripts/claude/piped-check.ts refuses a while/until loop on pgrep -f/--full with the PID-wait remedy; lanes.md states the rule.
Proof: test/claude/piped-check-hook.test.ts refuses three loop shapes, allows a kill -0 PID wait, a bare pgrep and a read loop.
